what_happened: Task description asserts the two named suites are the sole remaining place where a hardcoded gate count survives; planning-time grep found three more: test-verify-deploy-gate-selection-crash-net.sh:84 (seq 1 23, silently under-covering gates 24-26 since they were registered), measure-gate-costs.sh:352 (seq 1 23, so the cost model has never measured gates 24-26), and stale prose counts in gate-registry-lib.sh:4, measure-gate-costs.sh:94, test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh:6. All folded into plan Phase 3.

While verifying Phase 1 (gate 5,13,22), observed task 418 (explicit_lint_fixture_test_subject_resolution) has, concurrently and uncommitted on this shared tree, registered a real gate 27 in scripts/gate-registry.data and mechanically bumped the exact same five hardcoded assertions in test-gate-registry-resolution.sh that this task (489) targets for conversion in Phase 4 (case1, case32, case33 shifted 26->27/27->28). This is the live demonstration of task 489's own stated problem. Did not touch, revert, or claim task 418's work. Phases 4/5 of this plan will need to re-read test-gate-registry-resolution.sh fresh (not from this snapshot) once task 418 lands, per the plan's own re-read-before-edit discipline and the territory concurrency note naming 418 as a shared-path sibling to serialize against.

Phase 1's Tier Justification names test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh as part of the resolver-selected covering set. It failed (cold baseline, negative case, mtime independence) under current conditions, but the failure traces entirely to gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) exceeding its 30s per-gate timeout -- confirmed unrelated to this task's changes by running validate-state.sh --deep standalone (51.4s wall, exit 0, PASS) while agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/gate-registry-lib.sh and gate-store-fixture-lib.sh were untouched by the standalone run. Load average at the time was 1.45-4.87 with multiple concurrent /orchestrate sibling agents active in this session. test-gate-registry-resolution.sh and test-gate-cache-lib.sh (the other two suites in the covering set) and verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 13,22 all passed cleanly. gate 5 (manifest/content-hash) also failed in the --only-gate 5,13,22 check, but attributably to pre-redeploy drift (this phase's own new file not yet deployed, resolved at Phase 7) plus sibling task 418's concurrent uncommitted edits to gate-registry.data/common.sh/test-common-lib.sh/test-gate-registry-resolution.sh -- not a regression from this phase's own edits.

Phase 2's 28-suite resolver-selected covering run for verify-deploy.sh (test-check-task-references.sh through test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh) completed: 24 passed, 4 failed. 2 failures (test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh, test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh) are pre-existing/EXPECTED per run-all.sh's own baseline tracking (gate10 30s-timeout flakiness under concurrent load, and pre-redeploy deploy-vs-source drift respectively -- neither touches a Phase 1/2 file). 1 failure (test-lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh) is an unrelated classification gap for test-mcp-merge-target.sh, orthogonal to gate counts. 1 failure (test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh case(c): '--only-gate 27 expected exit 2, got 0') is the LIVE MATERIALIZATION of this task's own target defect: sibling task 418 registered a real gate 27 while this dispatch ran, so Suite B's still-unconverted hardcoded '27' out-of-range probe is now genuinely in-range and the assertion is stale -- confirmed NOT caused by the Phase 2 single-sourcing edit (the old inline max loop reads the same gate_registry_ids and would derive the identical live max=27). This is exactly the Phase 5 target and will be fixed when that phase converts the probe to REGISTRY_MAX+1. Error-message text confirmed byte-identical via git diff (no hunk touches the ERROR: --only-gate lines).

Phase 7's redeploy (deploy-headless.sh) landed successfully (all 9 of this task's file_scope files deployed byte-identical to source, confirmed via diff) but the deploy's own post-deploy full-battery verify-deploy.sh run returned RESULT=landed_verify_red (2 of 41 checks failed), not landed_verify_clean. Both failures are confirmed UNRELATED to this task: gate10 (validate-state.sh --deep) exceeded its 30s timeout under current concurrent-session load (same pre-existing flake documented in Phases 1/2/6's issues -- standalone run elsewhere in this dispatch took 51.4s and passed); gate24 (lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh) reported 2 violations, both in agent-system/extensions/memory/context/project/memory/{memory-setup.md,memory-troubleshooting.md} recommending a non-existent '/ide' command -- entirely within the memory extension's docs, nothing to do with gate counts or any of this task's 9 declared file_scope files. Confirmed this task's own slice is clean: verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 5,13 (manifest parity/content-hash equality, orphan detection) both PASS post-deploy, proving the new gate-store-fixture-lib.sh library file is correctly registered and deployed. Per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, the full gate set's outcome is attributed to the batch overall, not required to be independently green by this scoped dispatch.

The dispatch description framed the two target suites (test-gate-registry-resolution.sh, test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh) as 'the sole remaining place a hardcoded gate count survives.' Codebase reads during planning found three further sites of the identical defect class not covered by that framing: scripts/tests/test-verify-deploy-gate-selection-crash-net.sh ('for n in $(seq 1 23)', silently under-covering gates 24-26 rather than going red -- which is why it was absent from the original five-broken-assertion inventory), scripts/measure-gate-costs.sh ('for _g in $(seq 1 23)', the cost model that feeds every gate's timeout_s, silently never measuring gates 24-26), and three stale '23-gate'/'25-gate' prose counts in lib/gate-registry-lib.sh, measure-gate-costs.sh, and test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh headers. All three were included and fixed in Phase 3, bringing the task's actual goal (registering a gate requires no edits to unrelated files) fully in scope rather than leaving two silent-drift sites standing. Separately, the live registry's own max moved from 26 to 27 (a sibling task registered a real gate) WHILE this dispatch was converting the two target suites, providing a direct, live demonstration of the defect this task fixes, and confirming (via Phase 7's final 28-suite run) that the conversion actually resolves a real red test case (test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh's case (c)) rather than only a hypothetical one.
